title: Events alert — 2026-11-22
body:
**Mon Nov 23, 15:45 CET (09:45 ET):** S&P Global flash PMIs — the first macro print after the correction (Nov 23 week-ahead calendars, Trading Economics/eOption). Weak readings trim December-hike odds (~95–98% priced) and support relief; hot prints compound pressure on the 40–60% equity band. Power/utilities are least exposed; keep the cash sleeve as the buffer into Wednesday's October PCE (Nov 25, 14:30 CET, 08:30 ET).

**Tue Nov 24, ~22:05 CET (16:05 ET):** Dell Technologies (DELL) Q3 — the chain's components-layer AI-server bellwether, reporting after close. Watch AI-server backlog and margin guidance: an in-line result is the first hard datapoint after the AI unwind; a soft AI guide hits the infrastructure sleeve (VRT, SMCI, ANET) and semis demand read-through (NVDA, AVGO, MU). Consensus figures not verified for this run.

Derived from research/chain-dossier-2026-10-30.json (DELL in chain) and cited week-ahead sources. Research material, not investment advice.
